static_traits.name: Lin Mei
static_traits.family_status: 与妻子结婚，Has two children；妻子总体支持，但因其“供给not足”的自责而使关系受到一定影响
static_traits.social_status: 主要Social support来自妻子，但其倾向于将压力内化、难以向妻子袒露脆弱；其他社交网络Not mentioned
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；既往without类似心理问题与治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 配合度高，表达清晰，逻辑性Good；能自我Reflection但自我苛责明显；起初略显紧张，整体语气克制、认真

basic_info.main_problem: 我not断觉得自己对家庭的供给not够，尽管我作为Truck driver很努力Work；这种not足感在几年前财务Increased stress时出现，并在看到其他家庭度假、露营时加重。
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的“对家人not够好”的感觉已影响身心健康，我希望在治疗中处理这些想法与情绪。
growth_experiences: 几年前家庭财务压力上升后，开始产生对“供给not足”的自卑与Anxiety，认为自己的价值与能否让家人过上“最好的生活”高度绑定。
今年夏天without法负担家庭度假，在社交媒体看到其他家庭旅行照片后，自责与失败感显著增强，随后通过延长工时、接额外配送来“补偿”。
日常每晚收工后反复Reflection是否“提供得足够”，Low mood并影响睡眠与Work表现；与妻子的关系因此紧张，尽管妻子表达感激与支持，但其仍难以向妻子敞开以免让她担心。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not够能干
One's value as a partner and parent depends on financial provision and tangible experiences (such as holidays, camping)

special_situations.event: Seeing photos on social media of other families going out on vacation or camping
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能给家人提供度假/更多活动，就说明我失败、I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compensating and proving oneself by working overtime and taking more deliveries
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在辜负家人/I am not as good as others

special_situations.event: Working long hours后在一天结束时Reflection“我是否提供得足够”
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我仍然感到not够，那就代表事实如此，我确实not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pressures himself and keeps extending work hours to be 'enough'

special_situations.event: 今年夏天因预算限制而without法安排家庭度假
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连一次度假都负担not起，就说明我让家人受苦、我作为提供者失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately looking for more shifts and extra deliveries to 'make up for it'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这It is all my fault，I let them down

special_situations.event: 在意识到自己已能稳定供养家庭时，仍以“还not够”为标准来评价自我
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有做得更多、给得更多才算称职，已有的努力与成果并not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate已有成就、持续抬高标准并加班

core_conflict.wish: 渴望成为可靠而被肯定的提供者，让家人幸福并获得without条件认可
core_conflict.fear: Fears making family suffer, being seen as a failure, and losing the partner's respect and intimacy
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of worth and control through self-pressure and overwork
Repression脆弱与需求以避免让妻子担心、维持“强者/提供者”形象

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的提供者、容易One who disappoints the family
object_relations.object_representation: 对我抱有期待、若我not给足就会失望的家人/伴侣

object_relations.self_representation: A parent at a disadvantage in comparisons
object_relations.object_representation: An idealized and judgmental 'other families' (reference others on social media)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被建议向妻子表达内在压力或谈及“供给not足”的感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 表达脆弱会让妻子担心，也意味着我not称职、在失败
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoids emotion words and expressions of need, tone is restrained, emphasizes the factual statement 'I will work harder', reducing pauses and self-exposure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在社交媒体看到他人度假或谈及今年without法负担度假时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人的度假象征我not称职，并预示我必须做得更多才能not被嫌弃
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use“应该/必须”类语句强调责任与供给，快速转向加班计划与目标，淡化个人情绪与限度。

manifestations: 被“必须成为完美提供者”的角色期待束缚，难以在Work与家庭之间Freedom选择与取舍
用加班来对抗Anxiety，牺牲自主与休息
not愿向妻子袒露not安以免让其担心，选择把压力内化
在比较中感到自我隔离与not足
outcomes: 负性反刍增加、Lowered sense of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Uses 'I should/must give more' as the only standard of self-evaluation
Treats external indicators such as 'whether one can go on vacation' as the yardstick of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When talking about feelings, quickly shifts to work plans and overtime arrangements, avoiding vulnerability and needs
把关注点从内在AnxietyDisplacement到行动与任务上

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worries about burdening the wife, suppresses expression
High-frequency self-blame and negative rumination, hard to internalize positive feedback

positive_force: Stable job and a continuous sense of responsibility, willing to give for the family
Partner (wife) expresses gratitude and support, providing emotional resources
具有自我Reflection与求助动机，愿意尝试新方法
Already able to basically secure family life, with realistic providing ability
negative_force: Excessively binds self-worth to economic provision/visible activities (vacations), seeking external validation
过度比较与negate正向证据，情绪化推理与非黑即白思维
Repression脆弱、难以沟通需要，角色期待僵化（“应该/必须”）
长期疲劳与Sleep impaired，进一步降低情绪调节能力与关系质量

target_behavior.behavior: 为缓解“供给not足”的Anxiety而延长工时与频繁加班
antecedent: Sees others' family vacations/camping on social media
面临家庭预算紧张或without法安排度假时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将“提供更多”与“个人价值”直接等同的核心信念，伴随比较与negate正向信息的认知偏差
target_behavior.function: 逃避内疚与Anxiety、寻求控制感与外部认可
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental exhaustion、Sleep affected、与妻子沟通减少，Work表现与关系质量进一步下降

target_behavior.behavior: 持续的负性反刍与Self-denial（如“I am not good enough”“not管多努力都not够”）
antecedent: Sees social comparison cues of others vacationing and camping
感到疲惫或入睡前的自我Reflection时段
Talking about family spending and budget
